evidence.text: The company is building what it calls an “agentic cloud”, infrastructure designed specifically for AI agents rather than adapted for them.

Contact us Min slice Small slice Large slice Max slice 1 core / 2GB / 50GB FAQ: Questions, answered 01 What is Granite? Granite is full-stack AI infrastructure, designed from scratch for agentic workloads. Two ways in: deploy and own your own dedicated infrastructure with Granite Infrastructure, or use compute, storage and agents across the network with Granite Web Services. Both run on the same foundation, so the guarantee of control is identical whichever you choose. 02 What does 'full control' mean? That your data, your encryption keys and your agents stay inside the boundary you choose, enforced by the architecture. Nothing leaves that boundary unless you decide it does, and no outside entity can compel access. 03 Can I start on Granite Web Services and deploy Granite Infrastructure later? Yes. It's one foundation, so you can consume capacity on Granite Web Services today and deploy your own unit. Deployed Granite Infrastructure units interconnect to become part of the same network. 04 What do I need to host a Granite Infrastructure unit? A prepared pad, a power connection and cooling. The unit is a self-contained, liquid-cooled container that deploys at your chosen site 4 to 9 months from contract. Final power, GPU and footprint specifications are confirmed against your site. 05 Which AI models can I run? Granite Web Services is model-agnostic. Bring open-weight or licensed models, and change them as new ones are released. The value sits in Hero OS, the layer that runs your agents, and you always keep the keys. 06 Where does my data live, and can I get it out? Wherever you choose, and it stays there by architecture. There's no egress lock-in, so you're not penalised for moving data. 07 What runs underneath both products? A stateless operating layer, Mycelium OS, so control and resilience are properties of the system. 08 Does Granite help with regulatory compliance? Granite gives you control over where your data lives, who holds the keys and which jurisdiction applies, and those controls are enforced by the architecture. That makes audits simpler. You still need your own legal and compliance review. 09 Where are you today, and how do I start? The platform is live and in deployment today, with the first Granite Infrastructure unit shipping in [MONTH] 2026.
